display.purpose: Page titles and login headline only.

body.purpose: Default table, form, and metadata reading.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, and compact status markers.

narrative.componentPhilosophy: Compact product-surface controls for assistant, admin, and platform workflows with restrained gold linework.
dos: Use gold only for intent, focus, and structural emphasis.
Prefer border and tonal separation over decorative depth.
donts: Do not use large dark surfaces.
Do not use glassmorphism or marketing-page styling.
reuseGuidance: Preserve warm ivory surfaces, ink-heavy typography, and bright champagne-gold edge contrast as a matched set.
Use the style as the default baseline for authenticated assistant, admin, and platform product surfaces, not marketing pages.
Keep gold on lines, focus, active states, and premium actions instead of flooding large fills.
